name: ai-enabler
description: Machine-driven delivery from a Jira ticket to a pull request, without spec-driven development, plus metrics of AI usage and of delivery flow.

plugins.name: ai-enabler
plugins.description: Jira ticket to pull request: intake through the Jira MCP server, repository analysis, plan, implementation, tests with a coverage threshold, independent parallel review with auto-fix, and shipping. Two human gates: the plan and the ship.

plugins.name: ai-enabler-metrics
plugins.description: Usage metrics captured by opt-in hooks (interaction, time, token cost) and delivery-flow metrics (pull request size, review waiting time, rework, Jira cycle time), reported as HTML dashboards with charts. A metric is a KPI only when the team gives it a target.
